description: Persisted window geometry + the Developer-mode web inspector. b165928 also listed an inline {identifier: allow-open-devtools} object here; `open_devtools` is an APP command, not a plugin command, and app commands are never permission-gated in Tauri v2 — so no such identifier exists and every desktop build died with 'Permission allow-open-devtools not found'. Split out of default.json because tauri-plugin-window-state is only a dependency on macOS/Windows/Linux (src-tauri/Cargo.toml) — the crate doesn't compile for iOS/Android, so its permission can't be in a capability that mobile also loads (D-105-adjacent: it broke the iOS build with 'Permission window-state:default not found').
